mapper.insert: INSERT INTO enterprise_similarity_cache (source_enterprise_id, target_enterprise_id, model_name, source_text_hash, target_text_hash, similarity, reasons, is_deleted) VALUES (#{sourceEnterpriseId}, #{targetEnterpriseId}, #{modelName}, #{sourceTextHash}, #{targetTextHash}, #{similarity}, #{reasons}, 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE similarity = VALUES(similarity), reasons = VALUES(reasons), update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, is_deleted = 0
